appointments_email_check.name: appointments_email_check
appointments_email_check.value: "appointments"."email" is null or char_length("appointments"."email") between 3 and 254

appointments_clinic_note_check.name: appointments_clinic_note_check
appointments_clinic_note_check.value: "appointments"."clinic_note" is null or char_length("appointments"."clinic_note") between 1 and 500

payments_needing_attention_idx.name: payments_needing_attention_idx
payments_needing_attention_idx.where: "payments"."attention_reason" is not null and "payments"."attention_resolved_at" is null

payments_attention_resolved_check.name: payments_attention_resolved_check
payments_attention_resolved_check.value: ("payments"."attention_resolved_at" is null) = ("payments"."attention_resolved_by_staff_id" is null) and ("payments"."attention_resolved_at" is null or "payments"."attention_reason" is not null)

payments_manual_details_check.name: payments_manual_details_check
payments_manual_details_check.value: case when "payments"."provider" = 'manual' then "payments"."manual_reference" is not null and "payments"."received_on" is not null else "payments"."manual_reference" is null and "payments"."received_on" is null and "payments"."recorded_by_staff_id" is null end

payments_manual_reference_check.name: payments_manual_reference_check
payments_manual_reference_check.value: "payments"."manual_reference" is null or (char_length("payments"."manual_reference") between 1 and 100 and "payments"."manual_reference" = btrim("payments"."manual_reference"))

business_closures_note_check.name: business_closures_note_check
business_closures_note_check.value: "business_closures"."note" is null or char_length("business_closures"."note") between 1 and 80

business_hours_open_times_check.name: business_hours_open_times_check
business_hours_open_times_check.value:
("business_hours"."closed" and not "business_hours"."open_all_day")
        or ("business_hours"."open_all_day" and not "business_hours"."closed" and "business_hours"."opens_at" is null and "business_hours"."closes_at" is null)
        or (not "business_hours"."closed" and not "business_hours"."open_all_day" and "business_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "business_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "business_hours"."opens_at" <> "business_hours"."closes_at")

practitioner_hours_open_times_check.name: practitioner_hours_open_times_check
practitioner_hours_open_times_check.value:
("practitioner_hours"."closed" and not "practitioner_hours"."open_all_day")
        or ("practitioner_hours"."open_all_day" and not "practitioner_hours"."closed" and "practitioner_hours"."opens_at" is null and "practitioner_hours"."closes_at" is null)
        or (not "practitioner_hours"."closed" and not "practitioner_hours"."open_all_day" and "practitioner_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "practitioner_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "practitioner_hours"."opens_at" <> "practitioner_hours"."closes_at")

practitioner_leave_note_check.name: practitioner_leave_note_check
practitioner_leave_note_check.value: "practitioner_leave"."note" is null or char_length("practitioner_leave"."note") between 1 and 80

practitioners_title_check.name: practitioners_title_check
practitioners_title_check.value: "practitioners"."title" is null or char_length("practitioners"."title") between 1 and 80
